serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I hate that part of the town…
Why did I go here again? I must have some death wish…
That’s almost the worst part of the city. Almost.
I can think of one place worse than this. More to the south there is an area full of squatters and outlaws. 
I heard that it’s considered a ‘no-go zone’ by the police. Spooky stuff.
There are some ugly rumors about that area. All sorts of illegal dealings take place there and no one bats an eye…
From what I know there was some leakage of a dangerous chemical substance, many years ago.
Authorities found out about it too late and a whole bunch of people got sick, some even died. {{wi}}Children…
After that, and a dozen lawsuits, the price of land there went to the ground. Everyone was scared, local residents started selling in panic and no developer wanted to deal with getting rid of these toxic substances that still probably dwell there to this day…
Now it’s a lawless place, full of people with nothing to lose.
I wonder…{{wi}} What kind of pieces of trash would live there even though the danger is so high? Who are they hiding from? Police?
Dangerous chemicals aren’t the only thing that’s dangerous there. All sorts of gangs took over. People I knew that went there were telling me that there’s no way to take a step without stepping on a used needle…
The best local authorities could do was to put a 20 feet tall wall around the whole area. There are some passages of course, but since there is no maintenance on this construction local ‘residents’ put a bunch of holes in it to save some time on trips outside of the zone.
I-I should go back home now. I'm a few kilometers from there so I might meet someone I would rather not meet…
